triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as mere generalization of the witness surface, but the module itself defeats that reading: the pre-fix ch73 composition is chapter-scale (hts_line-indexed parameter tables), its header already declares section-232 aluminum membership as a caller input, and its own `section_232_aluminum_component_rate` already gated on `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` — while the Brazil IEEPA carve-out alone stayed keyed to `entry_is_line_b`, a witness exemplar-line identifier with no counterpart in the source. The proof atom attached to that very formula cites a class-based exclusion ("The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02"), and the pinned release corroborates the class basis (9903.85.02 = "products of aluminum provided for in the tariff headings or subheadings enumerated in subdivision (g) of note 19"; 9903.01.77 excepts headings 9903.01.78–.83 and .90, and 9903.01.90 is the note 2(x)(iii)(b) Brazil carve-out class). So the fix re-grounds an ungrounded exemplar condition onto the source's class — untraceable_branch, not new coverage; I considered wrong_entity_or_scope and rejected it because "line b" is not a rival source population but an artifact of the test fixture.

inferred from verified sibling module index 72 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Scope of the meaning change: only the Brazil gate (identical edit in `ieepa_component_rate` and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions`). The second hunk — `ch73_s232_steel_heading_rate` / `section_232_steel_component_rate` moving from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02 — is provenance-only (source string, proof-atom citation_path, atom count); the excerpt text, `formula: '0.50'`, effective_from 2026-02-15 and the derived formula are byte-identical pre/post, so by the rubric that part is mechanical. 9903.82.02 does exist in the pinned corpus and carries "+ 50%" for note 16(c) derivative articles, so the re-grounding is also substantively right.

Not a same-PR artifact: `git log 198bee703e -- .../ch73/ch73.yaml` shows the `not entry_is_line_b` gate originated in b2858d659 ("Generated tariff-schedule compositions, batch 3") and survived 2a6bdb01d and the parent a9562cfd4, which introduced `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` for the aluminum component but left the Brazil gate on the exemplar flag.

Caveats a reviewer should weigh: (1) within chapter 73 (iron/steel articles) the set of entries that are section-232 aluminum articles may be small or empty, so the mis-priced population here could be latent rather than realized — the encoded-meaning defect is real either way, and the same one-line edit lands in every generated chapter composition; (2) `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still has `formula: entry_is_line_b` post-fix (proof citing 9903.01.33 "articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum"), so an ungrounded exemplar flag remains elsewhere in the module — evidence the fix was targeted, and a residual of the same class; (3) the proof excerpt's locator `us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219` resolves in the pinned release (us-rulespec-2026-08-08, rev3 notes) to a bare list of HTS numbers, not that sentence — page drift versus the module's "Rev. 15 vintage"; I verified the exception's substance indirectly through 9903.01.77, 9903.01.90 and 9903.85.02 rather than through that page.
